mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN MODEL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as activeCount, SUM(CASE WHEN MODEL_STATUS = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as draftCount, SUM(CASE WHEN MODEL_STATUS = 'INACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as inactiveCount FROM TBL_BUDGET_MODEL WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} AND IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT VERSION_ID as id, VERSION as version, CREATE_TIME as createTime, CREATOR_NAME as creatorName FROM TBL_BUDGET_MODEL_VERSION WHERE MODEL_ID = #{modelId} AND IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_BUDGET_MODEL ( MODEL_ID, MODEL_NAME, MODEL_CODE, MODEL_TYPE, MODEL_STATUS, APPLICABLE_SCOPE, BUDGET_CYCLE, MODEL_DESCRIPTION, CONFIG_PARAMETERS, CALCULATION_RULES, VERSION, COMPANY_ID, COMPANY_NAME, CREATOR_ID, CREATOR_NAME, CREATE_TIME, IS_DELETED ) SELECT #{targetModel.modelId}, #{targetModel.modelName}, #{targetModel.modelCode}, MODEL_TYPE, 'DRAFT', APPLICABLE_SCOPE, BUDGET_CYCLE, MODEL_DESCRIPTION, CONFIG_PARAMETERS, CALCULATION_RULES, '1.0', COMPANY_ID, COMPANY_NAME, #{targetModel.creatorId}, #{targetModel.creatorName}, NOW(), 0 FROM TBL_BUDGET_MODEL WHERE MODEL_ID = #{sourceModelId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
